htmlTitle: Contact Praxera Private Label | Praxera Private Label

params.headline: Get in touch with our private label team.
params.subhead:
Questions about private label supplements, or specific products in our catalog?

Reach out and we will get back to you within one business day.
Fill out the form below and one of our private label specialist will get back to you within one business days. You can also call directly at 1-800-325-1776 or email us at info@praxerasupplements.com

cards.content: info@praxerasupplements.com, Response usually within one business day.
cards.title: Email

cards.content: 1-800-325-1776, Mon-Fri 8am-5pm Eastern.
cards.title: Phone

cards.content: Praxera Supplements, 929 Harvest Lane, Williston, VT 05495
cards.title: Mailing address

params.content: Schedule a consultation. We will walk through your audience, the right formulations for them, branding options, and the timeline.
params.headline: Ready to launch your private label supplement line?

items.answer: Use the contact form on this page. It routes directly to the team and is checked multiple times per business day. Phone calls are also available. Email to info@praxera.com works but is slightly slower than the form.
items.question: What's the fastest way to get a response?

items.answer: Contact your account manager directly. If you don't have an account manager assigned yet, mention 'urgent existing order' in your form submission and we'll route appropriately. Production and quality issues are prioritized.
items.question: What if I have an urgent issue with an existing order?

items.answer: Business hours are Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm Eastern. Most messages submitted outside hours get a response the next business morning. We don't run 24/7 support, but we do respond promptly to legitimate urgent issues.
items.question: What hours are you available?

items.answer: Yes. Our facility is at 929 Harvest Lane, Williston, VT 05495. We host facility tours by appointment. Drop-in visits are not supported because manufacturing facilities have access protocols, but scheduled visits are encouraged.
items.question: Is there a physical address I can visit?

items.answer: Yes. Phone is welcome during business hours. The contact form is faster for non-urgent matters because it routes to the right person automatically. For complex conversations (scoping a new project, troubleshooting an order), a scheduled call works better than email back-and-forth.
items.question: Can I call instead of emailing?
